item.title: LOT-055: AQ create in HFRClient
item.body:
LOT-055
Closes #81
Claim: cloud/lot-055-sonnet

**Problem.** #532 shipped the AQ feed, per-topic check and new-since count; the create was left until its answer was captured (#558, `T50`, `T51`).

**Cause.** No client call for `addAlerte.php`, and #611 showed the AQ database refuses or silently changes some values depending on an unknown `sql_mode`.

**Change.** `AQClient.create(_:)` (HFRClient only, no new dependency): one POST through the cookie-less transport, no redirect followed, no retry, 5 s, legacy field order plus `from=SwiftHFR` (decided on #573). Success only on status 200 with body `1`; everything else (redirect, transport failure, other status or body) is `AQCreateError.unconfirmed`, never a success; refusals are not captured on the live host, so none is read as one. Cancelled before sending is `cancelled` (nothing sent). The report is validated before sending (required fields, column sizes, BMP only, `int(11)` ids, `https://forum.hardware.fr` permalink with no port or userinfo). Spec `docs/lots/LOT-055-aq-client.md` updated, with the differences from legacy.

**Tests** (`AQCreateTests`, shown to fail without the change; mutations checked). `swift test` on HFRKit and `swiftlint --strict` pass locally.

**Review.** Round 1 and round 2 (Opus): REQUEST CHANGES, posted on the PR, all findings fixed (one commit each). Round 3 pending. Merge by the core orchestrator (state-changing flow).

### Ledger

```changelog
| T | La création d'une AQ n'affiche plus un code de refus : toute réponse autre que « 1 » est « non confirmée » ; les valeurs que la base refuse (trop longues, hors BMP, numéros hors plage) sont refusées avant l'envoi ; le corps porte `from=SwiftHFR`. | LOT-055 #828 | `MessagesView.swift:340-398` @ `2440d79`, captures T50, T51, T72-T90 |
```

comments.body:
Adversarial review round 1 (Opus 5.5), verbatim:

**Adversarial review (Opus 5.5): REQUEST CHANGES** — head 601bde66e2d6d5b30025210a76e99cabca603b30

The core rule holds: success needs status 200 and the trimmed body `1`. A redirect, a transport failure and any other answer are `unconfirmed`. The POST is never retried, carries no cookie and follows no redirect. The form matches HFR-PROTOCOL §6c LOT-055 and §8 "Create request". The four findings below are about tests, documentation and edge cases, not about that rule.

1. **Medium**, `docs/lots/LOT-055-aq-client.md:77-84` and the PR body `### Ledger`. The PR deliberately changes legacy behaviour in three ways:
   - Legacy showed any non-`1` answer to the user as a refusal code (spec, old "Create" section). Now it is `unconfirmed`.
   - Legacy sent emoji and oversized values (the database then answers `-1`, or silently changes them to `????` or cuts them). Now they are refused before sending.
   - The client now sends `from`, and an addition no longer sends `nom` or `topic_*`.

   "Intentional differences from legacy" lists none of these, and the ledger says "No legacy fix". Fix: list them in the spec, and add a `changelog` entry with the `ledger` label (AGENTS §8). Or justify on the PR why the entry belongs to LOT-134.
2. **Low**, `AQReportEncoder.swift:15`. Mutation test (LESSONS L01): I removed the 512-character limits on `nom`, `topic_titre` and `post_url`, and `AQCreateTests` stayed green. Fix: add cases at 513 characters for each of those fields.
3. **Low**, `AQClient.swift:79-84`. The client does not check `Task.isCancelled` before `perform`, so a task cancelled before sending ends as `unconfirmed(.transport(.cancelled))`. The app then tells the user that a report that was never sent "may have been recorded". Other write flows return a plain error here (`ModeratorAlertFlow.swift:78`, AGENTS learnings for LOT-048). Fix: check cancellation first and add a "not sent" case.
4. **Detail**, `AQReportEncoder.swift:35`. The 128 limit on the pseudo is checked before `lowercased()`, which can add scalars (`İ` becomes `i̇`). Fix: lower-case first, then validate.

**Verified**: 18 tests pass at the head; `swiftlint --strict` silent; mutation removing the three 512 limits stayed green (finding 2); making the pseudo optional failed 3 checks.

I will fix all four in one commit.

comments.body:
Adversarial review round 2 (Opus 5.5), verbatim (translated headings aside, text as returned):

**Revue adversariale (Opus 5.5) : CHANGEMENTS DEMANDÉS** — tête bdb1ca89249def79d3d97539128d48660326a1ac

1. **Moyenne**: `docs/lots/LOT-055-aq-client.md:82` ("The body is UTF-8 (legacy: lossy ASCII, accents lost)") and the `### Ledger` `changelog` row ("le corps est en UTF-8"). This is false. `legacyPercentEncode` (`MessagesView.swift:434-437` @ 2440d79) percent-encodes the UTF-8 bytes with only `A-Za-z0-9._-` kept, before the `.ascii` conversion. No accent is lost. HFR-PROTOCOL §6c (`T75`) says so too. As written, the ledger would record a legacy fix that never happened (L08/L21). Fix: drop the claim from both places. The only real wire difference is that a space becomes `+` instead of `%20`.
2. **Basse**: `request.maximumBodyBytes = Self.maximumCreateAnswerBytes` can be deleted with all `AQCreateTests` green. Fix: `#expect(request.maximumBodyBytes == 4096)`.
3. **Basse**: `url.hasPrefix(forumPrefix)` accepts `https://forum.hardware.fr.example.net/…` and `https://forum.hardware.fr:8443/…`. Fix: require scheme `https`, host `forum.hardware.fr`, no port, no user info; keep the prefix check.
4. **Détail**: spec test counts wrong (9 tests, not 8; 19 run, not "18 cases"; 15 invalid reports, not 11).
5. **Détail**: new spec citations should add the `87fe0d1c` range (`createAQ` at `:342`).

Verified by the reviewer: 19 tests pass, swiftlint 0 violations, `ledger.py check-body --pr 828` passes; mutations caught except the 4 KiB cap and `answer.count <= 4`.

Round 2 fixes follow in one commit.
